1.consolidated_definition: "Guineo": fruto del árbol de guanábana (Annona muricata), una variedad de guineo caracterizada por su pulpa blanca y jugosa rodeada de una cubierta verde y espinosa.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Guineo: fruit of the guanabana tree (Annona muricata), a variety characterized by its white and juicy pulp surrounded by a green and spiny covering.
